This application, C790502PLX, requests the lease of City-owned property, Block 2608, Lots 58 & 60, located at Fulton Avenue and East 166th Street in the Bronx, to the South Bronx Roots Community Association, for the development of community open space. The proposed site has already been cultivated as a gardening demonstration area. Some residents of the surrounding tenant-managed properties have planted individual plots as well as contributed to cultivation of a com- munal garden, all with considerable effort and minimal resources. The plans for this site include the continued introduction of new gardening techniques, with the aid of such technical assistance groups as the Cornell Extension Service and the Council on the Environment.
